create_SE_instance: create a SentEval SE instance with params, batcher, and optional prepare function
eval_single_task: evaluate a sentence embedding model on a single SentEval task like SST2 or STSBenchmark
eval_multiple_tasks: evaluate a sentence embedding model on multiple SentEval tasks by passing a list of task names
run_probing_tasks: run linguistic probing tasks like Length, WordContent, Depth, or Tense to analyze sentence representations
configure_SE_params: configure SentEval SE parameters including batch_size, seed, kfold, and classifier hidden units
